note: Multi-class issuers (#53): conversion ratios to the traded class, with filing evidence. Per-class counts come from each 10-K's XBRL instance (share_class_counts.json). A class with no ratio here leaves that year's shares blank.

us-gaap:CommonClassBMember.evidence: Class B Convertible Common Stock (eliminated by the 2022 Reclassification; 10-K 0000016918-26-000011 glossary 'Reclassification'). 1:1 if-converted basis is shown in the filer's own XBRL: 10-K 0000016918-18-000033 Note EPS, diluted Class A 200,745 thousand >= basic Class A 171,457 + basic Class B 23,336 thousand.

16918.diluted_evidence: Profit years: STZ's diluted Class A count is if-converted (includes Class B), e.g. FY2018 200,745 thousand. Loss years (FY2020, FY2022, FY2023, FY2025) report diluted = basic Class A (conversion anti-dilutive), so Class B/Class 1 are added at 1:1. 'auto' picks per filing.

us-gaap:CommonClassBMember.evidence: 10-K 0001701605-21-000026, Note Equity: 'Each share of Class A and Class B common stock and the associated membership interest in BHH LLC form a paired interest ... GE is entitled through BHH LLC Units to receive distributions on an equal per share amount of any dividend paid'. Owner earnings are consolidated (include GE's LLC interest), so paired Class B + LLC units count 1:1 as Class A (fully exchanged basis).

1701605.diluted_evidence: Class A diluted weighted-average shares exclude the paired Class B/LLC units (noncontrolling interest), so those are added at 1:1 using the per-class basic count when tagged, else the cover count. Class B was fully exchanged by 2023 (10-K 0001701605-24-000033 basic Class B 0).
